description: Multi-source recall oracle ensemble (GT-building reference, far over budget)
name: 30min

description: Baseline: self-contained trained boundary grouper over fresh PP-DocLayout regions + fresh PaddleOCR-VL region OCR. Fully independent (no cached dumps), caller-measured 5.95 sec/page. Reproduces the prior dump-based record (0.3815) — confirms the PaddleOCR grouper number is honest. Budget-compliant record.

Baseline + higher-res region crops (resize cap 1600->2560). Small real gain over exp_001 (0.3802->0.3826, new record). Adversarial review clean: budget-compliant 5.91 sec/page, no overgeneration, holdout consistent. 1952 dense-classifieds still the weak point (0.269) — resolution helps a little elsewhere but isn't the 1952 lever.

Reproduce column-structured route: Qwen3-VL-8B on 3-column crops + structured-JSON article prompt. FAILED: over budget (65.65 sec/page) AND 0.1934 (far below baseline). The structured JSON makes the 8B merge whole columns into giant blobs — recall collapses (0.16-0.68), blob matches up to CER 21.9. Did NOT reproduce archived exp_045 0.46. Lesson (matches Fable report): JSON inflates decode + wrecks segmentation. Next: plain-text on columns + trained grouper, or historical-fine-tuned model.

CHURRO-3B (historical-fine-tuned, page-trained) per-region + grouper. FAILED (DQ): killed over budget (~130 sec/page — its huge vision max_pixels forced max_num_seqs=8, crippling throughput) AND garbage quality — on 1885 (only completed issue) mbench=0.155, cer=6.0: the page-trained model HALLUCINATES on tiny region crops (output ~6x longer than GT). Region crops are OOD for CHURRO. score=1885-only proxy. Lesson: page-trained OCR models need page/column input, not region crops.

Article-level OCR: grouper decides boundaries from cheap per-region text, then OCR each article union-bbox crop (context-rich) with PaddleOCR-VL. NEW RECORD 0.3946 @ 8.74 sec/page (budget-compliant, holdout +0.027 not overfit, no overgeneration). Real gain from context but NON-uniform: 4 issues up (1895 +0.083), 2 DENSE issues down (1935 -0.063, 1952 -0.017) — mis-grouped regions -> huge multi-column article crops -> blobs (worst CER 23.2). Fix next: blob-guard (fall back to per-region text when article-crop OCR is degenerate/too long).

exp_005 + GT-free length-ratio blob guard (fall back to per-region text if article-crop len outside [0.5,1.8]x region-text len). NOT a record: 0.3931 < exp_005 0.3946. Guard is too blunt — helped 1935 (+0.016) but reverted legitimate gains on 1925 (-0.020). Flaw: article text being LONGER than region text is usually the GAIN (fuller transcription), not a blob, so a length guard reverts wins. Budget-compliant 8.66 sec/page. Next: geometric (width) guard, or stronger model on article crops.

Qwen3-VL-8B on article crops (8B for region + article OCR). OOM during the article-crop pass — article union-bbox crops are BIGGER than region crops (tall multi-region blocks), so 8B blows past 24GB even at max_num_seqs=32. Incomplete/DQ. 8B on big crops is memory-hostile on a 3090. Fix: AWQ-4bit 8B (~5GB weights) for room + speed (report E1). Note: 8B is only better WITH context (per-region 8B=0.334<PaddleOCR 0.38; column-8B=0.46), so 8B-on-article-crops is worth pursuing via AWQ.

AWQ-4bit Qwen3-VL-8B on article crops (article-level OCR pipeline). Budget-compliant @ 31.78 sec/page but 0.3668 < record exp_005 0.3946 — worse on every issue. Article context helped the 8B (per-region 8B 0.334 -> article 0.367) but the specialized 0.9B PaddleOCR-VL still beats general 8B at article granularity. CONFIRMS: specialized OCR model > general VLM for this historical text, regardless of crop size. General-VLM path is a dead end. Not a record.

Article-level OCR (PaddleOCR-VL) + geometric fill-ratio guard: use article-crop text only when the article regions form a tight block (sum-region-area/union-bbox-area >= 0.5), else fall back to per-region text. NEW RECORD 0.4071 @ 8.66 sec/page (+0.0125 over exp_005). Fixed the dense-page blob regressions (1935 +0.040, 1952 +0.020) by catching scattered mis-grouped articles, kept the context gains. Adversarial review clean: budget-compliant, no overgeneration, gains on the previously-weak issues (mechanism-targeted, not overfit).

exp_009 + CLAHE contrast enhancement on page images. REJECTED: 0.4024 < record exp_009 0.4071, only 2/6 issues improved (fails the >=4/6 adoption rule), and did NOT help the target 1952 (-0.005). Confirms VLMs are robust to gray-level; contrast distortion hurts. Preprocessing is a dead end for this model. Budget-compliant 8.64 sec/page.

CHURRO-3B (historical-fine-tuned) on ARTICLE crops (in-distribution, page-like) via two-model two-phase pipeline (PaddleOCR region OCR+grouping -> CHURRO article OCR). LOSES on all 6 issues (-0.011 to -0.080 vs exp_009 0.4071; wCER uniformly worse), 45.05 sec/page. CONCLUSIVE: no off-the-shelf model (general VLMs 2B-8B, historical-tuned CHURRO) beats specialized PaddleOCR-VL for this OCR at any crop size. Model-swap search exhausted -> adapt the winning model via LoRA fine-tuning (registry F7). Not a record.

LoRA fine-tuned PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, full 6-fold strict LOIO (train 5 issues GT article-crops->GT-text, ~261 pairs/fold, no augmentation), inference via fixed merged checkpoint. NOT a record: 0.4041 < base exp_009 0.4071 (net -0.003). Mixed per-issue: 1895 +0.013, 1935 +0.006, 1910 +0.001 up; 1885 -0.016, 1925 -0.014, 1952 -0.007 down. Small real-GT data overfits training-issue typography, hurts others (the risk LOIO is designed to catch — a non-LOIO eval would show a FAKE gain via memorization). Domain adaptation needs the amplifier: synthetic period-Italian augmentation or oracle distillation (more/cleaner data). Budget-fit ~10.85 sec/page.

Synthetic-augmented LoRA fine-tune (4000 degraded period-Italian crops from Gutenberg + real GT, 1 epoch), single-fold held-out 1935. CATASTROPHIC: 0.300 vs base 0.430 (-0.130); meanCER 1.663, 411 preds vs 303 base = HALLUCINATION/overgeneration. Literary-prose synthetic text pushed the OCR model toward generation (fluent Italian, 1.66x too long) instead of transcription; PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 RL-post-trained transcription behavior breaks under SFT. Both fine-tune variants now fail (naive -0.003 overfit; augmented -0.130 hallucinate). Fine-tuning this 0.9B for OCR is fragile with available data. 1935-only, not a full attempt.

Self-contained reimplementation of the column-structured 8B route (exp_045 target 0.4615): 3-column split + Qwen3-VL-8B structured-JSON + robust _extract_json parser. FAILED to reproduce: 0.2520 @ 191.97 sec/page (budget-compliant at the 5x cap 250, but far below record 0.4071). Root cause: my reimpl omits the real pipeline operators (esp. MergePages cross-column assembly) — under-generates (1910: 59 vs exp_045 142 articles) and worse wCER. exp_016 runs the ACTUAL exp_045 config via run_pipeline to reproduce faithfully.

NEW RECORD (budget-compliant): Ray-free column-structured 8B route — 3-column split + Qwen3-VL-8B structured-JSON (VLM_OCR_STRUCTURED_V2, 8192 tok) + MergePages + ParseIssue, operators called DIRECTLY in the experiment (no run_pipeline/Ray), VlmOcr loaded once for all 6 issues. 0.4275 avg vs record exp_009 0.4071 (+0.0204) @ 181.98 sec/page (in budget, cap 250). Faithful reproduction of the archived exp_045 config (which was 0.4615 on stale/older GT; on current GT it is 0.4275). ADVERSARIAL REVIEW = real gain, NOT gamed, but FRAGILE/uneven: not overgeneration (preds<GT everywhere, under-generates); holdout does NOT regress (tune 0.3767, holdout 0.3993, gap +0.0226); giant blobs present (1895 worst CER 157) but q-gate+wCER-cap penalize not reward them, so no score inflation. Carried by 1925=0.675 and 1910=0.566; COLLAPSES on dense layouts — 1895=0.128 (22 blobs, median 16.5k chars, 50% >5k chars, 23% high-repetition per probe) and 1935=0.334. 21x the cost of exp_009 (8.66 sec/page) for +0.02. In-budget gain per the any-gain-counts rule; ships only if the per-issue brittleness is acceptable vs exp_009's cheap uniformity.

NEW RECORD: hosted Gemini 3.7-flash, full-page input, JSON array output, thinking_budget=128, de-hyphenation post-process. 0.6115 on corrected GT (run2); pre-correction run1=0.6258 @ 13.66, run2=0.6045 @ 8.55 -- HIGH VARIANCE, log the mean (~0.615) not a single draw: 1910 swings 0.085 and 1952 article count went 717->166 between identical runs, consistent with full-page consensus agreement of only 0.17-0.84 (true-column reads agree 0.95-0.99). Beats exp_017 0.4263 by +0.185 and exceeds the 0.5941 oracle reference. Audit: no giant-blob inflation (0-2 blobs/issue, worst CER 5.8 vs exp_017's 22 blobs at CER 157), holdout gap -0.0295 (no overfit), recall 0.53-0.98. WEAK on 1952 (0.370, over-generates). CAVEAT: sec_per_page is API latency at 12-way concurrency, NOT GPU time -- not comparable to local routes; corpus cost is ~$5.7k at intro pricing (172,600 pages), doubling in 2027. Also: predictions carried ~1 paragraph/article until the unwrap_lines fix (0e4d383), unmeasured by the metric which joins paragraphs.
